channel.title: The Awesome Ledger — awesome-playwright
channel.description: New entries across the GitHub awesome ecosystem, diffed nightly.

item.title: playwright-soak-test — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Catches memory leaks by repeating a user flow in one browser session and tracking DOM node and listener counts.

item.title: Webcmd — via awesome-playwright
item.description: CLI built on Playwright that learns a site's navigation once and compiles it into deterministic per-site commands for coding agents.

item.title: AntiBrow — via awesome-playwright
item.description: Patched Chromium that returns a standard Playwright BrowserContext over CDP, with fingerprints applied in the C++ layer instead of injected scripts. MIT SDKs for Python and JavaScript, plus an MCP server mode.
